uncited: The Spherical Harmonics Encoder maps a 3D viewing direction vector into a set of spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients up to a specified maximum degree.
It solves the problem of representing directional information in a differentiable, basis-function expansion for view-dependent rendering.

It differs from [Spherical Harmonics Evaluation](3848-spherical-harmonics-evaluation.md) by performing the basis projection (encoding) rather than the dot product with coefficients (evaluation), and from [Spherical Harmonics Rotation](3985-spherical-harmonics-rotation.md) by operating on the raw direction vector rather than rotating existing coefficients.

- Degree 3: indices 9–15 ($m=-3 \dots 3$)
